source_name: SDAT Real Property Data Search
verification_note: Exact URL appeared in WebSearch result listing.
update_frequency: continuous; assessments on triennial cycle with annual phase-in
terms_notes: Site disclaimer: 'for information purpose only and the data is not to be used for legal reports or documents'. No account or CAPTCHA noted.
difficulty_reason: Per-parcel lookup only; bulk lives on the state Socrata portal.
notes: State-run assessor for all 24 MD jurisdictions. Assessment ratio 100% of fair market value; triennial reassessment (~1/3 of accounts yearly); increases phased in equally over 3 years; no single 'last countywide reassessment year' exists. Shows owner, assessment, land use, zoning, sale history.

source_name: Permanent Rent Stabilization and Protection Act (CB-055-2024)
verification_note: County program page, Legistar legislation page, and FAQ PDF URLs all in results.
update_frequency: statute; allowable increase updates with CPI-U
terms_notes: Effective 10/17/2024. Cap = lesser of 6% or CPI-U (Washington-Arlington-Alexandria) + 3%; senior facilities lesser of CPI-U or 4.5%; vacancy increases restricted; new fees prohibited. Exempt: post-2000 construction, landlords renting <5 units, owner-occupied.
notes: Underwriting-critical rent-growth constraint for PG multifamily.
